name: casetrack-role-management-security-prototype
description: Isolated local Firebase Emulator Rules feasibility prototype for CaseTrack

scripts.test:rules:baseline: npx --yes --package=node@22 -- node node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --only firestore --config ../../firebase.baseline.test.json --project demo-casetrack-role-rules "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/role-management.rules.test.js tests/station-isolation.rules.test.js"
scripts.test:rules: npm run test:rules:baseline && npm run test:rules:admin-panel
scripts.test:users: npx --yes --package=node@22 -- node node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-casetrack-role-prototype "node --test functions/tests/users-list.test.js"
scripts.test:stations: npx --yes --package=node@22 -- node node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-casetrack-role-prototype "node --test functions/tests/police-stations.test.js"
scripts.test:transitions: npx --yes --package=node@22 -- node node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-casetrack-role-prototype "node --test functions/tests/role-transitions.test.js"
